answer.answer: Total qualifying income for this lending package is $169,650.00, derived solely from W-2 Box 1 wages for tax year 2025. Maya Fictus reported $98,400.00 (w2_2025_maya_fictus.pdf) and Arjun Fictus reported $71,250.00 (w2_2025_arjun_fictus.pdf). Payslips and bank statements in the package are corroborating documents and are not added to the total per the qualifying-income definition.
caveats: Box 1 figures are from tax year 2025 W-2s; no earlier-year W-2s are present in the package.
The bank statement unit (bank-statement-2026-09-7c2e0d) has 1 held/PII-gated unit that could not be read, but bank deposits are excluded from qualifying income by definition regardless.
Arjun Fictus's September 2026 payslip (payslip-2026-09-arjun-fictus-scan-8ff645) returned 0 indexed units and could not be read; payslips are corroborating only and do not affect the total.
